title: Parsewave Fixes 206 Zapier Benchmark Bugs to Revise 28% of Kimi Grades
summary:
Parsewave reviewed all 600 public tasks in Zapier's AutomationBench to test whether the verifiers could be fooled by incorrect answers. The auditor used agents to generate plausible but wrong responses, resulting in the discovery of 206 bugs that the firm subsequently fixed in a release called AutomationBench Verified. When Parsewave replayed 1,235 runs of the Kimi K3 model using the updated graders, 344 of those entries, or 27.9%, received a different score.

The audit revealed significant disparities in grader accuracy, with pass rates for some tasks rising from 18.8% to 43.8% when overly strict verifiers were corrected. Conversely, pass rates fell from 60.2% to 49.7% where verifiers were too lenient. In one case, a submission failed to use required GDPR and HIPAA templates but still received a perfect score of 1.0 until the update reduced the score to 0.09. These findings affect the credibility of frontier labs that cite AutomationBench on their model cards.

AutomationBench Verified is out.

• Agents flagged 323 verifiers as suspicious, human review confirmed 206 real bugs, all 206 are fixed.
• We replayed 1,235 Kimi K3 runs on the old and fixed verifiers and 344 of them (27.9%) got a different grade
• Where verifiers were too strict, pass rate went from 18.8% to 43.8%

selectedTweets.text:
Agent benchmarks need audits of the graders, not only the tasks.

Parsewave reviewed all 600 public tasks in Zapier's AutomationBench, which frontier labs cite on their model cards.

It used agents to write convincing wrong answers, then had humans confirm which graders actually failed: 206 did.

AutomationBench Verified fixes every one.

On 1,235 Kimi K3 runs, the fixed graders gave a different verdict 27.9% of the time.

The clearest case is task 813. The grader checked the Salesforce notes but never looked at the DocuSign template. A submission that sent four contracts on the Standard template, instead of the required GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2 and Enterprise ones, passed 13 of 13 checks and scored 1.0. After the fix it scores 0.09.
